article.headline: Cal Poly wins 112-100 in OT against UC Riverside
article.description: — Jarred Hyder's 25 points helped Cal Poly defeat UC Riverside 112-100 in overtime on Saturday.
article.linkText: Cal Poly wins 112-100 in OT against UC Riverside

categories.description: UC Riverside Highlanders @ Cal Poly Mustangs

event.description: UC Riverside Highlanders @ Cal Poly Mustangs

keywords: UC Riverside Highlanders @ Cal Poly Mustangs
article.story: SAN LUIS OBISPO, Calif. -- — Jarred Hyder's 25 points helped Cal Poly defeat UC Riverside 112-100 in overtime on Saturday. Hyder also had nine rebounds for the Mustangs (11-17, 5-11 Big West Conference). Peter Bandelj scored 24 points while going 8 of 17 from the floor, including 3 for 9 from 3-point range, and 5 for 9 from the line and added eight rebounds. Cayden Ward shot 6 of 12 from the field, including 1 for 3 from 3-point range, and went 3 for 4 from the line to finish with 16 points. Barrington Hargress led the Highlanders (18-11, 11-6) in scoring, finishing with 25 points and six rebounds. Nate Pickens added 24 points and six rebounds for UC Riverside. Isaiah Moses also recorded 16 points, four assists and three steals. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
